user.title: 15-minute average power
user.description: Calculates the 15-minute average power of a power sensor, in fixed quarter hours (:00, :15, :30, :45), as the electricity meter does.

data_description.source_entity: A sensor in W or kW. For the grid, use the power at the meter.
data_description.name: Optional. The default is the name of the power sensor.
data_description.import_only: Turn on when the sensor is negative during export (solar). Negative values then count as 0 W.

error.unsupported_unit: The sensor must be in W or kW.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor already has a 15-minute average.

init.title: 15-minute average power

data_description.import_only: Turn on when the sensor is negative during export (solar). Negative values then count as 0 W.
data_description.agreed_power_1: In kW, from your network bill or Moj Elektro. Leave empty if you do not want a warning for this block.
data_description.agreed_power_2: In kW. Not lower than the block before.
data_description.agreed_power_3: In kW. Not lower than the block before.
data_description.agreed_power_4: In kW. Not lower than the block before.
data_description.agreed_power_5: In kW. Not lower than the block before.
data_description.day_entity: Optional. The calendar of the Holiday integration (a day with an event is a holiday) or the binary sensor of the Workday integration (on = working day). Without it, the built-in Slovenian holiday list is used.
data_description.block_entity: Optional. An entity whose state is the block, such as 2 or b2. It overrides the calculated block. Without it, the integration calculates the block from the season, the day and the hour.

init.description: The agreed power gives a warning when the projected 15-minute average goes over it. The tariff block is calculated; the two entities below can replace the calculation.

error.agreed_power_order: A higher block must not have a lower agreed power than a lower block (block 1 ≤ block 2 ≤ … ≤ block 5).
